title: Verify direct vs. connecting options before selecting a departure
description: Use when multiple departures satisfy a time constraint and you need to choose among them.
content: When several departures meet the arrival requirement, check the timetable for connections first. Prefer a direct service over one requiring a change, even if the connecting option departs earlier, to reduce transfer risk and waiting time.

title: Check fare restrictions before purchasing
description: Use when comparing ticket prices across candidate departures.
content: Discounted fares may be valid only on specific departures, so confirm which services the cheaper fare applies to before choosing. Factor in any additional costs such as seat reservations when comparing total price.

title: Complete booking with seat selection and platform reminder
description: Use after selecting a departure to finalize the journey plan reliably.
content: After choosing a service, reserve a specific seat if available, then set a reminder that includes the platform, coach, and seat number. Finally confirm the booking and retain the reference number for future retrieval.

title: Calculate knockout rounds from participant count
description: Use when planning a single-elimination tournament and needing to determine the number of rounds.
content: For a knockout bracket where each round halves the field, the number of rounds equals the number of times the participant count can be divided by two until one winner remains. Verify the round sequence explicitly before scheduling.

title: Estimate total event duration from per-round time
description: Use when checking whether a tournament or similar multi-round event fits within a time limit.
content: Multiply the time per round, including game time and breaks, by the number of rounds to estimate total duration. Compare this estimate against the available time window to confirm feasibility.
